text:
alex_ops: Heads up — crate B12 arrived at FRA depot this AM. 6 of 8 H100s have physical damage (bent heatsinks + one with smoking smell), 2 appear DOA on power rail. Photos uploaded: https://drive.redwood/shipment/B12 :grimacing:

maria_procure: Ugh. PO# 2026-4490, vendor invoice attached in procurement. Can vendor confirm RMA path + lead times? We need ETA to plan cluster allocation.

kevin_logistics: Filing an inspection report now. If we go air-replace we need AWB + proforma for customs (HS code 8471.80). Depot wants vendor preauth for outbound. Also need to confirm whether vendor covers return freight.

chris_sre: Impact summary: eu-west-1 cluster loses 4 usable GPUs if we pull the 6 damaged units for RMA (we can tolerate 2 degraded nodes). Canary for new image scheduled tonight — might need to pause or narrow to one AZ. Alex, can you list affected serials? :thinking:

alex_ops: Serial list (from crate manifest):
```
H100-CA-00123
H100-CA-00124
H100-CA-00125
H100-CA-00126
H100-CA-00127
H100-CA-00128
H100-CA-00129
H100-CA-00130
```
Damaged: 00123, 00124, 00125, 00126, 00127, 00128. DOA: 00125 (smoke), 00128 (no power).

sophie_vendor: Hi team — Sophie from NovaCompute support. Sorry about this. Please attach the full photos + manifest (we have the PO). We'll open an RMA immediately. Options: air-express (5 business days after approval), ground-replace (12–18 business days). We can cover DOA + damage under warranty; vendor will provide return labels for units we accept. For air we need customer acceptance of expedite fee unless covered by a contracted SLA.

maria_procure: Do you have an estimate for the expedite fee? Also confirm vendor will issue AWB and prefilled customs info so depot can hand off without delay.

sophie_vendor: Expedite fee estimate: EUR 2,800 per unit for air (inc. rush handling + air freight). We'll pre-generate AWB and commercial invoice. For this shipment we can waive expedite fees if you accept a partial immediate ship: we can send 4 refurbished H100s today by air and the remaining 4 replacements (new units) ground in 10–14 days. That keeps cluster capacity up.

kevin_logistics: If vendor sends 4 loaners, depot needs a crossdock RMA workflow: vendor AWB -> temporary asset tags -> serial escrow document. Can Nova compute attach a temp-serial manifest so we can track returns?

sophie_vendor: Yes, we'll include temp IDs and an RMA# (format NOV-RMA-YYYY-XXXX). We'll also include a short SLA for the loaners specifying return window and condition. RMA and AWB will be generated EOD CET once we get the photo attachments and final confirmation from finance.

nina_finance: Need the total cost delta if we accept air-refurb option vs ground full replace. Also confirm vendor waiver terms in writing. Please DM me the quote.

maria_procure: @nina_finance sending the line items now. Also @sophie_vendor please confirm in writing that vendor will absorb DOA replacement + return freights. Need that for PO amendment.

sophie_vendor: Confirming in writing — NovaCompute will absorb DOA unit replacements and return freight for those units. Written waiver/quote to follow.

chris_sre: Temporary mitigation: I can re-schedule the canary to single-AZ and shift some batch jobs to us-west-2 for 48–72h. If loaners arrive today we can keep schedule. Please flag ASAP.

alex_ops: Copy. Uploading detailed photos + manifest now: https://drive.redwood/shipment/B12/photos (shared with sophie_vendor).

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline for service/ml-inference paused automatically due to capacity drop in eu-west-1. Resume when @chris_sre or @alex_ops confirm capacity restored.

maria_procure: Next steps checklist: 1) Vendor generates NOV-RMA and AWB by EOD (sophie_vendor) 2) Nova ships 4 loaners by air express or 0 cost if waiver agreed (sophie_vendor) 3) Finance to approve expedite if needed (nina_finance) 4) Ops to confirm serial escrow + return labels (alex_ops, kevin_logistics) 5) SRE to adjust canary window (chris_sre).

kevin_logistics: I'll prep the depot note and customs pre-clearance once AWB arrives. Also recommend we document pictures in the claim packet in case insurance gets involved.

sophie_vendor: Understood. Generating RMA and AWB now — expect email and Slack update in ~3 hours. We'll include temp serials and the written waiver for DOA recovery. :thumbsup:

alex_ops: Thanks. Keep thread updated — time is critical.

maria_procure: tagging procurement lead for visibility: @nina_finance already on it.

nina_finance: Reviewing quote now. Will approve up to EUR 11k for expedite if vendor doesn't waive. Otherwise approve immediate.

sophie_vendor: RMA created: NOV-RMA-2026-1147 (draft). AWB pending final photo packet. Sending DM for secure serial list.

alex_ops: Received draft RMA. Confirming depot will accept vendor AWB once signed.

kevin_logistics: ETA for loaner delivery if air goes out today: 24–36h to FRA depot. If we get signoff, I'll coordinate dock slot.

chris_sre: Okay — I'll hold canary until loaners confirmed. Thanks everyone.

sophie_vendor: Closing loop — will post final docs and tracking here when AWB is created.

alex_ops: Thread resolved for now. Follow-ups on tracking + returns in the same thread.
